title: Aim
subtitle: 目標、目的、意圖——哪些詞真的接近 aim？
description: 目標、目的、意圖——哪些詞真的接近 aim？

words.note: 最常見、最自然的近義詞之一。表示希望在未來達成的結果，常用於個人、學習、工作、組織和長期計劃。

exercises.original: The main aim of the programme is to help more adults return to education.

options.explanation: 也接近，但更偏「為甚麼存在」。

exercises.original: Her long-term aim is to become financially independent.

options.explanation: 不自然地描述個人生涯目標。

exercises.original: The team's aim is to improve customer satisfaction over the next year.

words.note: 和 aim 很接近，但通常較正式，也更常指一個明確、具體、可執行或可衡量的目標。
words.example: 這個 aim 是否較正式、具體，而且像計劃中的明確工作目標？

exercises.original: One aim of the training course is to improve staff confidence when dealing with complaints.
The research project has three main aims.

options.explanation: 研究／項目語境非常自然。
通常不會列三個如此具體。

exercises.original: The first aim is to collect reliable data from at least 500 participants.

options.explanation: 明確且可執行的工作目標。
可用，但 objective 更精確。

words.note: 表示某件事存在、進行或被設計的原因。和 aim 很接近，但 purpose 更常回答：
words.example: Why does this exist or happen?

exercises.original: The aim of the workshop is to help parents understand the new curriculum.

options.explanation: 解釋 workshop 為甚麼舉行。

exercises.original: The aim of this document is to explain the application process clearly.

options.explanation: 也可，但不如 purpose 自然。

exercises.original: The main aim of the meeting is to decide who will lead the project.

words.note: 表示某人打算做甚麼或希望某件事達到甚麼結果。比 aim 更集中於人的主觀計劃或意圖。

exercises.original: Her aim was to make the message sound supportive rather than critical.

options.explanation: 明確是某人的主觀意圖。
可用但不如 intention 突出個人意圖。

exercises.original: The aim was never to replace teachers with technology.
His aim in asking the question was to understand the problem better.

words.note: 和 intention 很接近，但通常更正式、更濃縮。常見於法律、政策、分析或正式寫作中。

exercises.original: The aim of the law is to prevent companies from misleading consumers.

options.explanation: 法律／政策語境正式自然。
也可，但 intent 更濃縮正式。

exercises.original: The original aim of the policy was to reduce unnecessary paperwork.

options.explanation: policy intent 是常見正式搭配。

exercises.original: The committee questioned the aim behind the proposed rule.

options.explanation: behind a rule / proposal 很自然。
也可，但 intent 更偏背後用意。

words.note: 表示希望達到的具體結果，尤其常見於數字、期限、表現、銷售、減排、學習成果等可衡量情境。
words.example: 這個 aim 是否可以用數字、期限或明確標準衡量？

exercises.original: The company's aim is to increase online sales by 20 percent this year.

options.explanation: 也可，但 target 更可衡量。
也可，但不如 target 突出數字。

exercises.original: The government has set an aim of building 50,000 new homes by 2030.

options.explanation: 可用，但 target 更精準。

exercises.original: Our aim is to reduce average response time to under two minutes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 抱負不等於一般目標 Ambition 通常指較大、較長期、與個人成就有關的願望。
falseSynonyms.point: Her aim is to finish the course this year. Her ambition is to become a surgeon.

falseSynonyms.zh: 夢想不等於具體目標 Dream 可以很理想化，不一定已有計劃或行動。
計劃不等於目標 Plan 是「怎樣做」；aim 是「想達到甚麼」。
falseSynonyms.point: Our aim is to increase attendance. Our plan is to offer evening classes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 策略不等於目的 Strategy 是達成 aim 的方法。
結果不等於預先設定的目標 Outcome 是最後發生的結果；aim 是事前希望達到的結果。
優先事項不等於目標 某件事可以是 priority，但不一定是一個具體 aim。
使命不等於所有 aim Mission 通常較宏觀，描述組織存在的核心任務或長期方向。
願景／抱負不等於一般目標 Aspiration 通常比 aim 更理想化、更長期。
